variants.brief_summary: A deeper stony desert pavement with gentle dry washes
A broad enclosed playa with pale salt crust
Taller eroded ridges and branching gullies
Multiple dune rows transitioning to gravel
A deeper dry steppe with sparse scrub and rolling ground
Tiered limestone cliffs, recessed dry gorge and scree fans
variants.prompt: Create a new deeper variant of this desert escarpment for the same historical atlas. Show several tiers of pale limestone cliffs, a broad plateau broken by a recessed dry gorge, and foreground scree fans. Taller relief and a deeper footprint, around 3:2 painted width to height. Vary the cliff outline and internal forms. Match the reference ink and watercolor, muted buff stone, south-facing oblique view, and upper-left light. Entire organic silhouette within generous transparent margins. Actual transparent alpha outside. No backdrop, glow, lettering, roads, or buildings.
